title: Microsoft Surface Demo @ CES 2008
summary: A 2008 CES demo of the original Microsoft Surface, a smart table with multi-touch interaction. It shows touch manipulation of photos and objects on a tabletop display.
why: Cited as evidence that multi-touch interfaces predated the iPhone, and as an example of Microsoft innovation.

quote.text: See for example the Microsoft Surface (now renamed to PixelSense) from 2008
